authors: Djoumbou Feunang Y, Cao X, Assempour N, Ithayavani I, Arndt D, and Budinsky Z
desription: MetXBioDB is a biotransformation database that describes the transformation of small molecules in humans. this is a first partial release, which will be updated very soon.
copyright: MetXBioDB is offered to the public as a freely acessible database. It is part of BioTransformer, a software tool for the prediction ofsmall molecule metabolism. Use and re-distribution of the data, in whole or in part, for commercial purposes requires explicit permission of the authors and explicit acknowledgment of the source material (BioTransformer) and the original publication (see citation). We ask that users who download portions of the database, or use the BioTransformer software, cite the BioTransformer reference in any resulting publications.
citation: Djoumbou Feunang Y, Fiamoncini J, de la Fuente AG, Manach C, Greiner R, and Wishart DS; BioTransformer: A Comprehensive Computational Tool for Small Molecule Metabolism Prediction and Metabolite Identification; Journal of Cheminformatics; 2018; Submitted.
